name: Mikage Seishirou
source:
One day in the middle of a storm he went out to the riverside to take photos, and never came back. Some of the items he had with him have been retrieved from the river, but his body still has yet to be found. A date for his funeral has been decided, but there are still many unexplained circumstances surrounding his death. His previous surname was Tsukui, which changed due to his parents’ divorce, and he is the younger brother of Kentarou. He used to live in the Ghost Tower.

[Source: [url=http://www.tarhs.com/chara.html]official website profile[/url]]
